label: preparing
what: An ordinary commercial bread delivery: baker and freight agreed to prepare 32 loaves for pickup at 08:00 on day 1 and delivery to the bakery market stall by 09:00, for one emerald. Baking, stocking, pickup, handover and payment are logged. No record shows the mayor being told of this booking; deliberate secrecy is not established. No additional knowing helpers are supported.
